# Democracy and Me

> An educational platform dedicated to teaching American democracy, civic engagement, and political history through curriculum resources, expert analysis, and accessible content.

Democracy and Me is a collaborative project featuring educators, journalists, and scholars from Miami University and 91.7 WVXU that provides comprehensive educational materials on U.S. government, elections, constitutional history, and civic participation. The site combines lesson plans, expert commentary, and practical guides designed for high school students and engaged citizens.

## Key Topics

- American Democracy
- U.S. Constitution
- Civic Education
- Presidential Elections
- Founding History
- Constitutional Convention
- Voting Rights
- Political Parties
- Religious Freedom
- Civic Engagement
- American Government
- Revolutionary War
- Public Policy
- Electoral College
- Student Activities

## Core Educational Curriculum

- [Founding the United States](https://www.democracyandme.org/founding-the-united-states): Educational lesson on U.S. founding: Revolutionary War, Constitution, Constitutional Convention
- [Voting and the Electoral Process](https://www.democracyandme.org/voting-and-the-electoral-process): Guide to voting rights, voter registration, and election mechanics in the U.S.
- [The Electoral College](https://www.democracyandme.org/the-electoral-college): Educational resource on Electoral College system, voting, and electoral reform
- [Political Parties](https://www.democracyandme.org/political-parties): Curriculum resource on U.S. political parties, two-party system, and elections
- [Presidents and Campaigns](https://www.democracyandme.org/presidents-and-campaigns): Teaching materials on presidential campaigns and election history for high school
- [Individuals and Public Policy](https://www.democracyandme.org/individuals-and-public-policy): Lesson plan on public policy analysis and political perspectives for students

## Expert Analysis & Commentary

- [The Supreme Court's Dictionary is Missing an Entry: "Religion"](https://www.democracyandme.org/the-supreme-courts-dictionary-is-missing-an-entry-religion): Legal analysis of religious freedom, First Amendment, and Supreme Court doctrine
- [The 'Stars' in American Democracy: Spiritualism, Astrology, and U.S. History](https://www.democracyandme.org/the-stars-in-american-democracy-spiritualism-astrology-and-u-s-history): Analysis of spiritualism and astrology in U.S. history and Gen-Z civic discourse
- [Democracy isn't (March) Madness](https://www.democracyandme.org/democracy-isnt-march-madness): Media criticism on horse-race journalism and election coverage by Kathrine Nero
- [The countdown to 250: Rethinking civic pride before America's big birthday](https://www.democracyandme.org/the-countdown-to-250-rethinking-civic-pride-before-americas-big-birthday): Essay on civic pride and patriotism ahead of U.S. 250th anniversary

## Practical Civic Engagement Guides

- [Ready to talk turkey? Tips for tackling tough holiday conversations](https://www.democracyandme.org/ready-to-talk-turkey-tips-for-tackling-tough-holiday-conversations-when-politics-shows-up-before-the-pie): Practical guide to civil dialogue, fact-checking, and political conversations
